note: Outside review before the direction decision. One run each, native Dawn/Vulkan, AMD Radeon 8060S, 1920x1080, warm-up 60 + 240 frames, no sky (leak: sky). Default image sha256 unchanged (sponza e5a44335...).

ddgi_frontier._columns: GI ms static / moving (sponza-dynobj-n64-deform-bwave), allocated MiB, excess k16 bwave, excess k16 sponza-dynobj, static flicker fine % (sponza), light switch frames to 90 % / 50 % (sponza-dyn-switch200, 320 frames after the switch, end frame taken as converged), error vs sponza multi-bounce reference pixel / 8x8 block / bias

response_metric_flaw: The response curve takes the last frame of the run as the converged value. With 320 frames after the switch ddgi-100-128-u8-g1-noadapt still has 12.7 % left at frame 256; the 90 frames of phase 25 came from a shorter run.

frozen_pose_regions._note: Mean luminance of the indirect irradiance in image boxes (1920x1080: near left column 430-560 x 350-700, near right column 1340-1460 x 350-700, near floor 700-1200 x 800-1000, near right object 1080-1180 x 500-640). Poses frozen (--pose-frame), so DDGI has converged.
frozen_pose_regions.reading: The near objects that are black with RC and lit with DDGI in the moving sequence agree once DDGI has converged on the frozen pose: the difference in the sequence is the lag of DDGI, not light missing from RC.
